rule: primary: scenario cii, median over seeds 42-44 of oracle VAL recall; per pair, the setting (e10/e20) whose median recall of the pair's weaker class is higher. Pair verdict: both classes >= 0.80 and median benign FAR <= 0.05 -> 'separable for the gate' (the 12-label failure of this pair is primarily continual); weaker class < 0.70 -> 'feature limit' (joint training also fails); otherwise 'borderline'. Overall: both pairs separable -> 'primarily continual'; both feature limit -> 'primarily features'; else 'mixed'. Any other class with oracle median val recall >= 0.80 that a continual model lost (test recall 0) is listed as lost by the protocol.
